newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIAN BOXING CHAMP ON DAMAGE, SWEARING CHARGES.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIAN BOXING CHAMP ON DAMAGE, SWEARING CHARGES.

text.p: Former triple world boxing champion Jeff Fenech has been charged with obscene language and wilful damage to a police car after a disturbance on Australia's Surfers Paradise tourist area, police said on Sunday.
Fenech was arrested on Saturday after police were called to a house in Surfers Paradise, in northern Queensland state, police said.
He is due to appear in a local court within two weeks.
A spokesman for Fenech later told local reporters the former champion in various lightweight divisions denied the charges.
Fenech won the IBF bantamweight title in 1985, the WBC super-bantamweight title in 1987 and the WBC featherweight title in 1988.
